simple.meaning: עׇזִּיאֵלִי (ʻOzzîyʼêlîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “an Uzzielite (collectively) or descendants of Uzziel.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עׇזִּיאֵלִי (H5817) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 3:27, with occurrences in Numbers, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עׇזִּיאֵלִי (H5817) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עׇזִּיאֵלִי (H5817) before moving outward to related references.
